slides.teacher_cue: New sound — the /ɔɪ/ diphthong. Lips start rounded (like /ɔ/) then move to a spread position (like /ɪ/). Two spellings: oi in the middle of a word (oil, coin, join), oy at the end (boy, toy, joy). Same position rule as before: oi middle, oy end.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /ɔɪ/ cleanly as a smooth diphthong movement and understand the oi/oy position rule.
slides.correction_move: Model the lip movement: start rounded, glide to spread. Students copy with exaggerated movement. Then sort: coin, oil, soil (oi middle) vs boy, toy, joy (oy end).
slides.observation_note: Watch for flat /ɔɪ/ — the diphthong movement must be smooth and continuous.

slides.teacher_cue: Say oil — a liquid used for cooking or engines. oi in the middle (or at start). Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say oil orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model oil orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for the diphthong movement in oi and for /l/ at the end.

slides.teacher_cue: Show a coin. Say the word — oi in the middle. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say coin orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model coin orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /ɔɪ/ diphthong in oi.

slides.teacher_cue: Say join — to become part of a group. Reveal and blend.

slides.correction_move: Model join orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /dʒ/ onset and /ɔɪ/ vowel team.

slides.teacher_cue: Say boy — a male child. oy at the end. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say boy orally, connect meaning, then blend on the card.
slides.correction_move: Model boy orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for the oy spelling at the end — contrast with oi in the middle.

slides.teacher_cue: Say toy — something to play with. oy at the end. Reveal and blend.

slides.observation_note: Watch for the oy coda and /ɔɪ/ diphthong.

slides.teacher_cue: Say joy — great happiness. oy at the end. Reveal and blend.
